instruction.text: Select the words in the sentence that begin with sk-.

atoms.a: Skyler was skipping to the park when he tripped over a skateboard.
atoms.b: ((Skyler)) was ((skipping)) to the park when he tripped over a ((skateboard)).

atoms.a: He hit his head and skidded on the pavement.
atoms.b: He hit his head and ((skidded)) on the pavement.

atoms.a: Luckily, Skyler’s fall wasn’t too bad.
At worst, he will have a bump on his skull and some bruised skin for a few days.
atoms.b: At worst, he will have a bump on his ((skull)) and some bruised ((skin)) for a few days.

instruction.text: Select the words in the sentence that begin with tw-.

atoms.a: Twyla and her twin turned twelve last week.
They had a big birthday party, with nearly twenty kids.
atoms.b: They had a big birthday party, with nearly ((twenty)) kids.

atoms.a: The twins and party guests played Twister, twirled around with hula-hoops and took turns smashing open a piñata.
atoms.b: The ((twins)) and party guests played ((Twister)), ((twirled)) around with hula-hoops and took turns smashing open a piñata.

atoms.a: The twins were so happy with their party, they wished they could have it twice!
atoms.b: The ((twins)) were so happy with their party, they wished they could have it ((twice))!
